1.description: Terrain category 1: exposed open terrain, few or no obstructions (sea coast, flat treeless plains)

2.description: Terrain category 2: open terrain, well scattered obstructions 1.5-10 m high (airfields, open parkland)

3.description: Terrain category 3: numerous closely spaced obstructions up to 10 m (towns, industrial areas, suburbs)

4.description: Terrain category 4: numerous large high closely spaced obstructions (large city centres)

sources.gustFactor: IS 875 (Part 3):2015 Clause 10.2: gust factor method for h/b > 5 or f0 < 1 Hz, G = 1 + r √(gv² Bs (1 + φ)² + Hs gR² S E / β), r = 2 Ih, gv 3.0, Lh = 85 (h/10)^0.25 (70 in terrain 4), Bs = 1/(1 + √(0.26 (h - s)² + 0.46 bsh²)/Lh), S = 1/((1 + 3.5 f0 h/V̄h)(1 + 4 f0 b0h/V̄h)), E = π N/(1 + 70.8 N²)^(5/6), gR = √(2 ln(3600 f0)); turbulence 6.5 (Iz,1 = 0.3507 - 0.0535 log10(z/0.002), Iz,4 = 0.466 - 0.1358 log10(z/2.0), terrains 2-3 at 1/7 and 3/7 between); hourly mean factors k̄2 (Table 4); β 0.02 for RC (Table 34 of the code; set damping in Project Settings > Wind)
